# Vericairn 0.9.4

> The documentation set of Vericairn 0.9.4, frozen with the release: its 62 guides, references and release notes, each linked below by its title.

Links are relative to this file, which is docs/releases/0.9.4/llms.txt in the repository at the release's tag v0.9.4, and the root of vericairn-0.9.4-docs.zip. llms-full.txt holds every document below in one file, in this order.
